items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: I don't know who he played with, but he played, definitely they told me, in the old Civil War, he played the drums.

ctx.x: So, let's see. I think we've got your birth date and all that stuff about when you got started. I wanted to get you a little more about your grandfather. What was his name? My grandfather. Frank Giles.
Frank Giles. I see. And who did he play with?
